subject: Next steps: Dedicated capacity sizing call — PayNova
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@paynova.com>, Priya Bhandari <priya@paynova.com>
Cc: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 18 Aug 2026 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Next steps: Dedicated capacity sizing call — PayNova

Hi Alex / Priya,

Thanks again for taking the time today — great discovery call. Quick recap + proposed next steps so we stay aligned: 

- Goal: Schedule a 60–90 minute dedicated capacity sizing call (technical deep dive) to align on throughput, latency SLOs, and infra/network requirements for a Dedicated deployment.
- Who we’ll bring: me (AEs), Camila (Solutions Engineer), and the Dedicated onboarding team as needed.
- What we need from you before the call: ballpark traffic profile (RPS / requests per minute), avg tokens per request, peak windows, and any networking/firewall constraints.

Proposed time windows (PDT):
- Thurs Aug 20, 10:00–11:30 AM
- Fri Aug 21, 9:00–10:30 AM
- Mon Aug 24, 2:00–3:30 PM

If none of those work, send 2–3 slots that do and we’ll lock one in. I’m attaching a short capacity-sizing questionnaire that speeds the call (only a few fields).

Look forward to it — can get a calendar invite out once we have a time.

Best,

Marissa Cole
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai | (415) 555-0123

Attachment: capacity-sizing-questionnaire.pdf (pdf, 120KB)

From: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@paynova.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Priya Bhandari <priya@paynova.com>
Date: Tue, 18 Aug 2026 17:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Next steps: Dedicated capacity sizing call — PayNova

Hi Marissa,

Thanks for the recap — very helpful. Both Priya and I are available on Fri Aug 21 at 9:00 AM PDT. That works best on our side.

A few quick items so the call is productive:
- We expect ~150 requests/sec at peak for our primary endpoint, average ~45 tokens/request, spikes up to ~300 RPS for short windows (5–10 minutes).
- Latency goal: p95 end-to-end generation latency < 250ms (this is a business target; we understand infra variations).
- We’ll need the SE to confirm whether Redwood Dedicated supports persistent KV caches and how batching affects p95.

Can you confirm the invite and whether you need any infra contacts from our side (network/security) on the call?

Thanks,
Alex
Product Lead | PayNova
alex.johnson@paynova.com | +1 650-555-0199

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@paynova.com>, Priya Bhandari <priya@paynova.com>
Cc: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 19 Aug 2026 09:24:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Next steps: Dedicated capacity sizing call — PayNova

Alex — perfect, locking Fri Aug 21, 9:00–10:30 AM PDT. Calendar invite sent.

Camila (cc) will run the sizing portion — Camila, can you lead throughput/latency Q&A, and run through our sizing worksheet?

Alex / Priya — attached is the capacity-sizing questionnaire and a short network checklist. If you can fill the high-level fields ahead of time it’ll let us come prepared with a proposed Dedicated configuration (GPU type, instance counts, batching profile). Key fields that help us size:
- Avg requests per minute and peak RPS (you provided — thank you)
- Avg and max tokens per request
- Typical request distribution (percent chat vs. single-turn generation vs. embeddings)
- Desired p50/p95 latency targets and SLOs
- Any data residency or network firewall rules (eg, blocked outbound IP ranges)

High-level expectation from Redwood for the numbers you gave:
- With ~150 RPS, avg 45 tokens, and p95 target 250ms, we’ll likely propose a multi-GPU Dedicated pool with inference-optimized instances + persistent KV cache enabled. Exact config depends on model choice and quantization. We’ll bring a concrete proposal on Friday.

Attachment: capacity-sizing-questionnaire.pdf (pdf, 120KB); network-requirements.xlsx (xlsx, 45KB)

Thanks — talk Friday.

Marissa Cole
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference

From: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 20 Aug 2026 09:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Next steps: Dedicated capacity sizing call — PayNova

Marissa — thanks, I’ve reviewed Alex’s notes. I’ll prepare:
- A sizing worksheet with 2 config proposals (cost-optimized vs latency-optimized).
- A short slide showing how batching + KV cache affect p95 on common models.
- A list of sample logs/metrics to request if they can share (samples of request timestamps + token counts).

I’ll join the invite and drive the technical agenda. If you can loop in the Dedicated deploy lead after the call, we can fast-track a pilot.

Camila Reyes
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
camila.reyes@redwood.ai
